verdict.rationale: Medusa is a headless commerce platform. The storefront-related evidence covers only developer resources: storefront development guides, Gatsby/Next.js starter kits, and code-based hosting. A community user notes that headless means 'I have to write my own interfaces.' Nothing in the pack shows professionally designed themes or no-code editing of layout, sections, or branding; starter kits are developer building blocks and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can launch a polished storefront from professionally designed themes and customize layout, sections, and branding without code
